events.event: Prabowo allocates Rp240 billion to handle karhutla in West Kalimantan, per a CNN Indonesia headline.
events.why_it_matters: Shows how much money the state is putting into fire and haze response as pressure grows to declare a national disaster.

events.event: A forest fire on Gunung Sumbing has burned 779 hectares of forest and is not yet extinguished, per CNN Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: 779 hectares · fire not yet out · 23 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Mountain forest fires are spreading beyond Sumatra and Kalimantan peatlands into Java.

events.event: Kemenag prepares a distance-learning (PJJ) mechanism for pesantren on three islands affected by karhutla, per CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: Haze is now disrupting schooling for pesantren students, not just flights and health.

events.event: Haji and Umrah Minister Gus Irfan admits he appointed his own child as an expert staffer (tenaga ahli) at the Kemenhaj, per CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: A nepotism question at the ministry that runs haji, which affects millions of waiting pilgrims.

events.event: KPK searched the house of Fadia Arafiq; her husband reportedly visited Jokowi the same day, per CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: A new KPK search with a link to a former president draws attention; details of the case are not yet confirmed.

events.event: Hercules and Maruarar Sirait trade barbs over Tanah Abang land, per CNN Indonesia; follows the Rp800 million cash Hercules' lawyer handed to KPK.
events.why_it_matters: A public clash between an ormas leader and a minister over land.

events.event: 38 residents of Tidarsari, Magelang Selatan fell ill with food poisoning after eating siomai at a neighbourhood gathering; health office investigating.
events.key_numbers: 38 people · symptoms mild to moderate · 1 or 3 still hospitalised (article inconsistent) · first report 20 Oct · samples sent to provincial lab
events.why_it_matters: Another food-poisoning cluster while MBG poisoning remains in the news; this one is a private gathering, not MBG.
events.spreading_evidence: detik news indeks top item, 23 Oct

events.event: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Tibet, China at 22:33 local time on 22 Oct, per AFP via detik.
events.key_numbers: M7.0 · depth 10 km · ~390 km NE of Lhasa · China Level II emergency response · casualties unconfirmed (a related-link headline claims 16 dead, not verified)
events.why_it_matters: A major quake abroad; Indonesian viewers often ask whether it affects them (it does not).
events.spreading_evidence: detik news indeks, 2 items (video + report), 23 Oct

events.event: A DPRD member in Mempawah, West Kalimantan was named a suspect in a land-burning case and detained immediately, per detik.
events.why_it_matters: Karhutla enforcement now reaches an elected official, not just companies.

events.event: NTB provincial government threatens heavy sanctions over shrimp-pond waste dumped into the sea off Sumbawa, per detik.
events.why_it_matters: Marine pollution from aquaculture affecting local fishers.

events.event: The search for Jessica, who drowned in Komodo National Park, was closed after 10 days without finding her, per detik.
events.why_it_matters: Tourist safety in a flagship destination.
